authMethods.label: OAuth or key-pair JWT access token

usage.reason: The REST User API documentation shows no last-login field or activity log endpoint. Login and query history are only in SNOWFLAKE.ACCOUNT_USAGE SQL views, which the REST endpoints documented here cannot read.

evidence.quote: Lists the users in the system.
Parameter to limit the maximum number of rows returned by a command.

assumptions: The documentation does not state the API host name. The only Snowflake domain in the source is snowflake.com (docs.snowflake.com), so I used https://{account}.snowflake.com with the account identifier supplied by the customer. Real Snowflake account hosts are normally under a different domain (snowflakecomputing.com), which the source does not mention, so this host must be confirmed and corrected before use.
The documentation excerpt does not describe authentication. I assumed a bearer token (OAuth or key-pair JWT) in the Authorization header. Please confirm the supported methods.

The response body schema is not shown. I assumed the user list is a top-level JSON array, and that each user has name, email, display_name, disabled and created_on fields. These names are unconfirmed.
The 'disabled' flag is assumed to be a boolean: true maps to inactive and false to active. Other states such as locked or pending are not covered.
The list endpoint has showLimit and fromName parameters but no documented cursor or total, so I set pagination to none. Large accounts may return a truncated list, which needs checking.
The caller needs a role with privileges to see all users (for example a user-admin role). The documentation does not say which.
Usage is marked unavailable. A last-login field may exist on the user record, but the documentation does not show it, so I did not guess.
Dates are assumed to be ISO 8601 strings. They could be epoch values.
